parameters.content:
## 1. Read & classify appointments

The workflow starts on a daily schedule (or manually, for testing). It loads every row from your Google Sheet, then the Classify step tags each appointment with its lifecycle stage — new, reminder-due, no-show or completed — and the Switch routes each one to the right message on the right.

The **Configuration** node is where you set your business name, reminder timing and review link, so you rarely need to touch anything else.

## 2. Send the right message

Each lifecycle stage gets its own Gmail message:

- **Confirmation** — sent when a booking is first added
- **Reminder** — sent before the appointment to cut no-shows
- **No-show win-back** — a gentle nudge to rebook after a miss
- **Review request** — sent after a completed visit to collect 5-star reviews

Edit the subject and body in each Gmail node to match your brand voice.

## 3. Update the record

After the right email is sent, the appointment's row in your Google Sheet is updated with its new status and a timestamp.

This is what stops the same customer from being emailed twice, and keeps your sheet as the single source of truth for every appointment.

## Send appointment confirmations, reminders and review requests with Google Sheets and Gmail

Run your entire appointment lifecycle on autopilot — confirmations, reminders, no-show win-backs and review requests — straight from a Google Sheet using Gmail. Built for clinics, salons, spas, agencies and any business that books appointments.

### How it works
1. Every morning the workflow reads your appointments from a Google Sheet
2. Each appointment is classified by its lifecycle stage (new booking, upcoming, no-show, or completed)
3. The Switch routes it to the right email — a confirmation, a reminder, a win-back, or a review request
4. Gmail sends the matching message
5. The sheet is updated so nobody is contacted twice

### Setup steps
1. Copy the Google Sheet and add your appointments (name, email, date, status)
2. Connect your Google Sheets and Gmail credentials
3. Open the Configuration node and set your business name, timings and message text
4. Activate — it runs daily at 8 AM (change this in the Schedule Trigger)

### Requirements
- Google account (Sheets + Gmail)
- A Google Sheet of appointments with a Status column

### Customising this workflow
- Edit the copy in each Gmail node to match your brand voice
- Add SMS (Twilio) alongside email for reminders
- Change the schedule, or add more stages in the Classify and Switch nodes
